questions.question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs would make the given equation correct?

288 × 72 + 36 ÷ 12 - 6 = 20770
questions.solution:
Given equation: 288 × 72 + 36 ÷ 12 - 6 = 20770

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) × and −

Given: 288 × 72 + 36 ÷ 12 - 6 = 20770

After interchanging the signs we get;

→ 288 − 72 + __**36 ÷ 12**__ × 6 = 20770

→ 288 − 72 + __**3 ×**____** 6**__ = 20770

→ **__288__** − 72 __**+ 18**__ = 20770

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. All pens are sketches.

II. All sketches are books.

III. Some books are colours.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are pens.

II. Some colours are sketches.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Given Statements:

I. All pens are sketches.

II. All sketches are books.

III. Some books are colours.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/266af87d1616e8b7fb4b39ef2b20ea62b7405a1f3c8432fdbb8ec5bff5a205da.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are pens - **True **(Because, those parts of books which are sketches are also part of pens)

II. Some colours are sketches- False (Because, No definite relation is given between colours and sketches, so this can be a possibility only)

So, only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".

questions.question: In a code language, 'BOARD' is written as ‘40’ and ‘TIME’ is written as ‘47’. How will 'CUDDLE' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3cf684fc9c82a90ebdaae30f16bf56cc2b36c5a153e5a41cc8460a0e2f84635.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Sum of the place value of all numbers = Code of the word.

'BOARD' is coded as '40'

⇒ 2 + 15 + 1 + 18 + 4 = 40.

'TIME' is coded as '47'

⇒ 20 + 9 + 13 + 5 = 47.

Similarly, for '**CUDDLE**'

⇒ 3 + 21 + 4 + 4 + 12 + 5 = 49.

So, 'CUDDLE' will be coded as '49'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option ".
